title: RingCentral Pricing in 2026: RingEX and RingCX Plans and Prices
summary: RingEX Core is $20, Advanced $25 and Ultra $35 per user a month paid annually for 1 to 100 users, or $30, $35 and $45 monthly. RingCX starts at $65.
body_markdown:
RingCentral publishes prices for RingEX, its business phone product, for accounts of 1 to 100 users. Core is $20 per user a month paid annually, or $30 paid monthly. Advanced is $25 or $35. Ultra is $35 or $45. Accounts of more than 100 users are quoted. RingCX, the contact center product, is $65, $95 or $145 per user a month paid annually, or $75, $110 or $165 paid monthly. The pages were read on November 18, 2026.


Trellus publishes this guide and sells a competing dialer. Every RingCentral detail below comes from RingCentral's own pricing pages, promotion page, fee pages and Terms of Service, opened on November 18, 2026. No price here comes from a review site. No RingCentral account or trial was used and nothing was tested. Prices are RingCentral's US list prices in US dollars.


## RingCentral pricing at a glance


RingCentral's[RingEX pricing page](https://www.ringcentral.com/pricing/business-phone) has a selector for the number of users with three bands: 1-5, 6-100 and 100+. The 1-5 and 6-100 bands showed the same prices. The 100+ band showed "Contact us for pricing" on every plan. A switch changes between annual and monthly payment.


RingEX plans per user a month in US dollars, for the 1-5 and 6-100 user bands, from RingCentral's own pricing page, read on November 18, 2026. The 100+ band is quoted. Plan Paid annually Paid monthly Seat minimum Free trial What is included for calling


RingEX Core $20 $30 None stated 14 days; Try free button on the 1-5 band Unlimited calling in the US and Canada, IVR, on-demand call recording, 100 toll-free minutes, 25 SMS per user a month, video meetings


RingEX Advanced $25 $35 None stated 14 days; Try free button on the 1-5 band Core plus CRM integrations, automatic call recording, call monitoring with whisper and barge, multi-site management, 1,000 toll-free minutes, 100 SMS per user a month

AI Customer Engagement Bundle Not published Not published None stated Contact sales Ultra plus AI Receptionist, Conversation Intelligence, the Call Queues Booster and the Business SMS Booster


RingCentral's[RingCX pricing page](https://www.ringcentral.com/pricing/contact-center) has no user-count selector. It says paying annually saves up to 13%. Every plan card has a Contact sales button, and the page states no seat minimum and no free trial.


RingCX plans per user a month in US dollars, from RingCentral's own contact center pricing page, read on November 18, 2026. Plan Paid annually Paid monthly Seat minimum Free trial What is included for calling


RingCX Standard $65 $75 None stated None stated Voice and more than 20 digital channels, ACD, IVR, skills-based routing, call recordings, and a dialer with voice broadcast, preview, predictive and progressive modes

The RingEX page's FAQ describes a 14-day free trial for new subscribers with voice, auto attendant, meetings, team messaging and fax. It says the trial supports up to 20 phone lines. A footnote on the same page says the trial is limited to five users and two desktop phones. Both say SMS is not available in the trial.


## What changes the real cost of RingCentral


The per-user price is public for smaller accounts. The bill also depends on the user band, the payment term, add-ons, numbers and fees.


### User-count bands


The RingEX prices above are for the 1-5 and 6-100 bands. The 1-5 band has Buy now and Try free buttons. The 6-100 band shows the same prices with Contact sales and View demo buttons. Above 100 users, no price is published. Ask for a written quote at your user count.


### Annual or monthly payment


Monthly payment costs $10 more per user on each RingEX plan. Ten Advanced users come to $250 a month paid annually, or $350 paid monthly. On RingCX, monthly payment adds $10, $15 or $20 per user.


### The six-months-free promotion


On November 18, 2026, a banner on the RingEX page offered new customers six months free. The[promotion page](https://www.ringcentral.com/dg/6-months-free) says it is for a limited time and requires a minimum 24-month subscription for companies with 1 to 399 employees, with other restrictions. It gives no end date. The page says new customers who sign up in 2026 get no bills until 2027. The regular prices in the table are unchanged.


### Numbers, toll-free minutes and texting


Each RingEX plan has a monthly allowance of toll-free minutes and SMS, shown in the table. The page says more toll-free minutes can be bought and states no rate. Other number and message prices on the page:


- **Additional toll-free or local numbers:** $4.99 a month each.
- **Vanity numbers:** a $30 one-time fee and $4.99 a month.
- **International numbers:** from $5.99 per user a month.
- **International toll-free numbers:** $14.99 per user a month and a $25 one-time fee.
- **High Volume SMS:** from $0.0119 per message sent or received.


Unlimited calling covers the US and Canada only. The page says international calls are charged at RingCentral's published international rates.


### RingEX add-ons


The RingEX page lists four add-ons with a price and no stated unit: AI Receptionist from $39, Conversation Intelligence from $60, the Call Queues Booster at $35 and the Business SMS Booster at $25. Push to Talk is $5 per user a month. Ask RingCentral how each add-on is billed.


### RingCX add-ons


On RingCX, AI Quality Management, AI Interaction Analytics, AI Agent Assist and AI Supervisor Assist each start at $25 per user a month. AI Workforce Management starts at $20. The RingCX page states no per-minute or usage charges, so ask whether calling minutes are included.


### Taxes and fees


A footnote on the RingEX page says other taxes and fees may apply. It names the Federal Universal Service Recovery Fee, the E911 Service Fee, the Compliance and Administrative Cost Recovery Fee, a 911 Fee, and state and local taxes. RingCentral's[cost recovery fee page](https://www.ringcentral.com/legal/taxes-and-fees/taxes-and-compliance.html) says that fee is not a tax and is not required by any government. The fee pages read state no amounts, so ask for an itemised quote.


### Renewal and early termination


RingCentral's[Terms of Service](https://www.ringcentral.com/legal/eulatos.html) say services renew automatically for periods of the same length as the initial term, unless either party gives notice at least 30 days before the term ends. If a customer ends services early, other than for RingCentral's material breach, the terms say the customer must pay all sums remaining for the rest of the current term.


## Who RingCentral fits and who it does not


RingCentral describes RingEX as a business communications platform that combines calls, meetings and chat in one app. That fits a company replacing an office phone system, with users who call, text, fax and meet in one place.


RingCX fits a contact center. Its plan table lists inbound routing, digital channels and a dialer with predictive and progressive modes on every plan.


RingEX is a weaker fit for a sales team that wants to dial through lists. The RingEX plan comparison table lists no power dialer or parallel dialer. A team that needs one should ask RingCentral about RingCX, which starts at $65 per user a month.


It is also a weaker fit for a buyer who wants a fixed public price above 100 users, because that band is quoted.

The[Trellus power dialer](https://www.trellus.ai/power-dialer) plan, Power, is $99.99 per seat per month. The[Trellus parallel dialer](https://www.trellus.ai/parallel-dialer) plan, Power + Parallel, is $149.99 and calls up to five numbers at once. Both are bought online with no seat minimum. RingEX's list prices are lower than either Trellus plan and cover a full phone system. Trellus costs more per seat and adds power and parallel dialing. ## Frequently asked questions


### How much does RingCentral cost per user?


For 1 to 100 users, RingCentral lists RingEX Core at $20, Advanced at $25 and Ultra at $35 per user a month paid annually, or $30, $35 and $45 paid monthly. RingCX is $65, $95 or $145 paid annually. Larger RingEX accounts are quoted.


### Do RingCentral prices depend on the number of users?


The RingEX page has three bands. On November 18, 2026, the 1-5 and 6-100 bands showed the same prices, and the 100+ band showed "Contact us for pricing". The RingCX page has no user-count selector.


### Does RingCentral have a free trial?


Yes, for RingEX. The pricing page describes a 14-day free trial for new subscribers, without SMS. The Try free button appears on the 1-5 user band. The RingCX page lists no free trial.


### What is the difference between RingEX and RingCX pricing?


RingEX is the business phone product, from $20 per user a month paid annually. RingCX is the contact center product, from $65 per user a month paid annually. The RingCX plan table lists a dialer and digital channels; the RingEX table does not.


### Does RingCentral include a dialer?


RingCX does. Its plan table lists a dialer with voice broadcast, preview, predictive and progressive modes on every plan. The RingEX plan table lists no power or parallel dialer.


### What fees does RingCentral add to the price?


The RingEX page says a Federal Universal Service Recovery Fee, an E911 Service Fee, a Compliance and Administrative Cost Recovery Fee and state and local taxes may apply. The amounts are not published on the pages read.
